description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_FontFamily, which is responsible for validating a list of font-family names against CSS specifications. It includes logic for handling generic names, quoted font names, and safe character validation for font names.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_FontFamily
classes.description: A class for validating font-family lists according to CSS specifications.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a mask of valid characters for font names, including ranges for letters, digits, and UTF-8 bytes.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a font-family string by parsing comma-separated font names, handling quotes, generic names, and character safety, and returns a sanitized font-family string or false if invalid.
